rca_of_the_issue.bug: Quick status filter and config modal state checkboxes used s.id (UUID from DB) instead of s.code (status code like 'ABERTO') as values
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: TicketStatusResponse model has two identifier fields: id (UUID primary key) and code (status code string). Dashboard.js allStatuses SelectItem and Checkbox components used s.id for values, but ticket.status field stores the code ('ABERTO'). The filter effectiveStatuses.includes(t.status) compared UUIDs against status codes → 0 matches.
rca_of_the_issue.fix: Changed value={s.id} to value={s.code} in SelectItem, and changed includes(s.id)/toggleEditState(s.id) to includes(s.code)/toggleEditState(s.code) in config modal state checkboxes. Also updated data-testid from config-state-{s.id} to config-state-{s.code} for better testability.
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: 1. Login to dashboard. 2. Open quick status filter, select any status. 3. Observe 0 tickets shown even though matching tickets exist. OR: 4. Open Configurar Dashboard, select a state, save. 5. Observe no filtering applied to ticket lists.
